final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM hand_counts), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share FROM hand_counts CROSS JOIN total), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT batting_hand, record_count, share, share / avg_share AS relative_to_average FROM shares CROSS JOIN average_share
